divergence.reason: Java cannot plan ORDER BY over the FIRST duplicate-alias leg's unique column ('Cascades planner could not plan query', live-verified 4.12.11.0 — the second-leg form answers there); Go binds the sort key per-attribute and orders correctly. Go exceeds Java on the read side.
